s1.title: Fund vs. founders
s1.body: One founder-side suit (Run The World) and one founder removal with a16z on the board (Zenefits, 2016) across about 1,456 companies. Each is 0.07%, under the 1% threshold, so no penalty. No lost case or fraud finding.

s2.title: Ability to support you
s2.body: Money 5 of 6: $15B+ raised Jan 2026, but follow-on reserves aren't public. Media 6 of 6, capped. Help after the check 3.25 of 5.5: the platform team and intros are a16z's own claims, so they count at half; −0.5 for 2025 partner departures.

s3.title: Founder experience
s3.body: Two negative first-hand accounts (Run The World, Zenefits) are 0.14% of the portfolio, under 1%. a16z gets the default for a fund investing 10+ years with 500+ companies: 95%.

s4.title: Conflicts of interest
s4.body: Partners on boards of competing companies (Databricks, Fivetran), the ADV clause that incubated companies “will be in direct competition” with portfolio companies, and the 2023 Uniswap vote. Scaled across 88 investing partners.

bonus.title: Track record bonus
bonus.body: 16 years of investing with no significant pattern of harm. +1 per 5 years, up to +3.

pen.title: Regulatory penalty
pen.body: DOJ board-seat probe: open, no charges (−2). Coinbase shareholder suit against Andreessen as a director (−0.5). SEC record clean. No OFAC, EU, UK or UN sanctions match for 44 people and the firm's entities. Anne Neuberger's Russian and Iranian counter-sanctions cost 0 by rule.

range.title: Likely range 86–97
range.body: Likely 86–97. For each part we couldn't fully check, we took a plausible bad and good outcome under the v2 rules, weighted it by the share left unchecked, and combined the parts as independent (root-sum-square). Biggest swings: founder experience (−6.3), down-round behavior (−5), blocking deals (−4), the DOJ probe turning into charges (−2.4). If every downside hit at once: 63.

cov.title: How much we could check
cov.body: Weighted by score points, we could check 39% of what this score needs. Down-round behavior and blocking deals (18 points) have 0% coverage; founder experience 10%. A thin record is not a clean record.

rel.title: Verified sources only
rel.body: Every scored item has a working link, names a16z, and tags its role. 17 Toxy sources were excluded (dead links, content farms, copycat names).

rank.title: Top 1 fund among 11 Toxy tracks
rank.body: Example only. a16z's v2 score (95) is compared with the other 10 funds' old Toxy scores (highest: Lux Capital 83). They haven't been rescored on v2, so this rank isn't like-for-like. On Toxy's old scores a16z ranks 11 of 11.

rules.title: How Toxy Score v2 works
rules.body: Every fund starts with full points and loses them only for verified evidence about its own behavior. Bad events are measured as a share of the portfolio: under 1% costs nothing, 1–3% small, 3–10% medium, over 10% large. Regulatory is penalty-only: open probe −2, charges −10, fine −10 to −20, fraud −30, sanctions −50 plus a red banner. Score is capped 0–100.

sanc.title: No sanctions found
sanc.body: We screened 44 a16z people and the firm's 2 legal entities against OFAC, EU, UK and UN lists on OpenSanctions (Oct 2, 2026). Every hit was a namesake or a politically exposed person (e.g. Scott Kupor, a US official), not a sanctions designation. A sanctions finding needs an exact identity match (date of birth, nationality, ID), never a name match.
